patch_resolves_note: The fixed OpenThread patch still executes the mesh-local-prefix comparison, but replaces the memcmp size argument with `GetMeshLocalPrefixLength()`, so the protected event runs with an 8-byte bound instead of the copied TLV header length.

root_cause_criterion.obligation: At the mesh-local-prefix connectivity check, the size argument passed to `memcmp()` must not exceed `sizeof(meshLocalPrefix.GetMeshLocalPrefix())`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reuses the copied TLV header length as the memcmp size, so the compare bound can exceed the fixed 8-byte Mesh Local Prefix field. The fixed program keeps the same comparison site but uses `GetMeshLocalPrefixLength()` for the bound, constraining the read to the field size.

nodes.state: At the memcmp sink, the compare length is greater than `sizeof(meshLocalPrefix.GetMeshLocalPrefix())`, so the read runs past the fixed 8-byte Mesh Local Prefix field embedded in the stack-local `meshLocalPrefix` object.

edges.relation: The exact compare length selected at the root-cause site is the same third argument later passed into `memcmp()` at the sanitizer sink.
